title: MZ Options on Title Screen cancel out BGS/BGM when leaving

posts.author: Jobhob
posts.body: I'm using a plugin that allows to setup title screen on map, and at the same time I'm turning on music via the map events, which causes it to cancel itself if player opens and closes the Options menu. This is really annoying, and I'd like to know if there's any way to fix this. Thanks.
